# ui::ExpandCollapseProvider

Header: `winui/ui/Automation.hpp`.

The ExpandCollapse pattern: a collapsed or expanded state (an [Expander](../layout/expander.md#uiexpander), a [ComboBox](../controls/combo-box.md#uicombobox), a [DropdownButton](../controls/dropdown-button.md#uidropdownbutton)). Implement every member.

```

```
